Years in Focus bundles the following independent command-line tools:

  ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe
  FFmpeg build: N-126086-ge5ecfe8970-20260812
  Platform: Windows x64
  Variant: LGPL (no --enable-gpl)
  Build provider: BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
  Binary source: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest/ffmpeg-master-latest-win64-lgpl.zip
  FFmpeg source revision: e5ecfe8970
  FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/e5ecfe8970

later. The corresponding license text is supplied in
LICENSE-FFmpeg-LGPLv3.txt. These tools are separate executables used locally
for optional audio processing and advanced output-quality processing.
